note: Keys are the Polish source texts from xs2lightburn.py. Translate the values only. Keep placeholders such as %s, %d, %02d and %% exactly as in the key, and keep \n and leading spaces. Save the file as UTF-8. Values you leave empty or remove are shown in English.

strings.\n\nProgram działa bez bazy; edytor nie: The program works without the database; the editor will not save changes while the file is damaged.
strings.%d elementów wyłączonych z obróbki w x: %d objects excluded from processing in xTool: moved to '(not processed)' layers with Output off
strings.pominięto %d elementów z ukrytych wars: skipped %d objects from hidden xTool layers
strings.UWAGA: %d elementów nie ma operacji w: WARNING: %d objects have no operation in xTool; they got a layer with power 0%s
strings.UWAGA: brak danych obrazu %s, pominięt: WARNING: no image data for %s, skipped
strings.UWAGA: brak opisu planszy %s, pominięt: WARNING: canvas %s has no description, skipped
strings.UWAGA: element %s bez położenia/skali,: WARNING: object %s has no position/scale, defaults used
strings.UWAGA: komponent %s bez elementów, pom: WARNING: component %s has no objects, skipped
strings.UWAGA: nie udało się odwrócić pikseli: WARNING: could not flip image pixels (Pillow missing or unusual format); image mirrored by negative scale, same look
strings.UWAGA: nieobsługiwany typ %s (%s), pom: WARNING: unsupported type %s (%s), skipped (e.g. text: convert it to a path in xTool)
strings.UWAGA: nieznane wymiary obrazu %s, pom: WARNING: unknown size of image %s, skipped
strings.UWAGA: obraz %s ma korekty xTool (%s);: WARNING: image %s has xTool adjustments (%s); the image was transferred without them
strings.UWAGA: obraz w formacie innym niż PNG/: WARNING: image is not PNG/JPG and Pillow is missing (pip install pillow); image skipped
strings.UWAGA: tryb obróbki %s (nie płaski); s: WARNING: processing mode %s (not flat); check the project manually
strings.UWAGA: uszkodzony lub nieczytelny obra: WARNING: damaged or unreadable image; skipped
strings.UWAGA: w pliku brakuje fragmentu %s: WARNING: the file is missing part %s
strings.UWAGA: za dużo warstw; elementy bez ob: WARNING: too many layers; unprocessed objects were merged into shared layers with output off (vectors and images separately)
strings.UWAGA: zerowa skala obrazu %s, pominię: WARNING: zero scale of image %s, skipped
strings.UWAGA: ścieżka %s ma błąd w danych, pr: WARNING: path %s has a data error; only its valid part was transferred
strings.%d materiałów o tych samych nazwach już:
%d materials with the same names are already in the database.

Yes: replace them with the imported ones.
No: add the imported ones with the suffix (import).
strings.%s (część operacji ma błędne wartości i: %s (some operations have invalid values and were skipped)
strings.%s: brak elementów do pokazania (szczegó: %s: nothing to show (details in the log)
strings.%s: włączone w xTool, w LightBurn ustaw: %s: enabled in xTool, set it manually in LightBurn
strings.baza materiałów %s jest uszkodzona (%s);: material database %s is damaged (%s); fix the file or delete it to recreate the default
strings.baza materiałów %s ma zły format (oczeki: material database %s has a wrong format (expected a 'profiles' list); fix the file or delete it to recreate the default
strings.Baza zawiera tylko PRZYKŁADY. Wpisz włas: The database contains EXAMPLES only. Enter your own tested parameters for your laser (Add or Import button). Actual tube power, lens, air assist and material batch change the result: run a test (LightBurn: Laser Tools > Material Test). Min power in cut rows is the corner power (Ruida).
strings.brak uprawnień do zapisu lub odczytu: %s: no permission to read or write: %s
strings.BŁĄD: nie ma w bazie materiału '%s' (lis: ERROR: material '%s' is not in the database (list: --list-materials)
strings.Dodaj pliki .xs lub .xcs. Kliknij plik,: Add .xs or .xcs files. Click a file to see its preview and layers.
Add files and click a file in the list.
strings.Dopisać przykładowe materiały? Twoje mat: Add the example materials? Your materials and changes stay; only examples whose names are not in the database will be added.
Editing works on one layer at a time.
strings.Folder zapisu (Enter = obok pliku xTool): Output folder (Enter = next to the xTool file):
strings.Folder zapisu (puste = ten sam folder co: Output folder (empty = same folder as the xTool file):
strings.kerf przeniesiony do LightBurn (np. %s m: kerf transferred to LightBurn (e.g. %s mm); check the offset direction on a test piece
strings.kerf z xTool pominięty (inna maszyna); k: xTool kerf skipped (different machine); kerf comes from the material database
strings.Konwertuj wszystkie pliki z listy: Convert all files in the list
strings.Kółko myszy: powiększ / pomniejsz. Prze: Mouse wheel: zoom in / out.  Drag: pan.  Double-click: fit.  Layout as in xTool.
strings.materiał '%s' nie ma ustawień dla operac: material '%s' has no settings for operation '%s': the layer has output off and power 0; complete the database or set the parameters manually in LightBurn
strings.Materiał (parametry z bazy dla Twojego l: Material (parameters from the database for your laser):
A material with this name is already in the database.
strings.Moc min nie może być większa od mocy max: Min power cannot be higher than max power
strings.moc min nie może być większa od mocy max: min power cannot be higher than max power
strings.moc musi być w zakresie 0-100%: power must be in the range 0-100%
strings.Nie można otworzyć okna (%s), tryb konso: Cannot open the window (%s), console mode.
strings.Plik bazy %s jest uszkodzony, więc zapis: Database file %s is damaged, so saving is blocked to avoid overwriting it. Fix the file manually or delete it and restart the program (a default database will be created).
strings.Plik lub ustawienia się zmieniły; podglą: The file or settings changed; the preview is reloading. Make the change again.
strings.Pliki (.xs, .xcs); kliknij plik, żeby go: Files (.xs, .xcs); click a file to preview it:
strings.Podaj ścieżkę do pliku .xs lub .xcs (pus: Enter the path to an .xs or .xcs file (empty line = done):
strings.Podejrzanie duże dane w archiwum:: Suspiciously large data in the archive:
strings.Pominięto błędne wpisy w %s:\n\n%s\n\nZa:
Skipped invalid entries in %s:

%s

Saving in the editor will remove them from the file (a backup %s.bak is made first).
strings.projekt wymaga %d warstw, a LightBurn ma: the project needs %d layers, but LightBurn has 30 (C00-C29)
strings.Przywróć wszystkie warstwy tej planszy: Reset all layers of this canvas
strings.prędkość musi być w zakresie 0-3000 mm/s: speed must be in the range 0-3000 mm/s
strings.rampa mocy przy wypełnieniu nie została: fill power ramp was not transferred
strings.Są ręczne zmiany warstw, których nie zap: There are manual layer changes not saved to .lbrn2 (no conversion since the changes). Close anyway?
strings.to nie jest poprawny plik .xs/.xcs (uszk: not a valid .xs/.xcs file (damaged JSON data)
strings.typ wypełnienia '%s' nieobsługiwany, uży: fill type '%s' not supported, normal fill used
strings.urządzenie LightBurn ma Mirror X: the LightBurn device has Mirror X
strings.urządzenie LightBurn ma Mirror Y: the LightBurn device has Mirror Y
strings.uszkodzony plik .xs (archiwum ZIP nie da: damaged .xs file (the ZIP archive cannot be read)
strings.UWAGA: %s zmienił się na dysku po ręczne: WARNING: %s changed on disk after manual layer edits; those edits were dropped
strings.UWAGA: zapamiętanego materiału '%s' nie: WARNING: the remembered material '%s' is not in the database; 'no change' selected.
strings.w pliku brakuje wymaganej części: %s: the file is missing a required part: %s
strings.Warstwa = numer w LightBurnie, * = zmien: Layer = number in LightBurn, * = changed manually. Colors in the drawing = LightBurn layer colors, gray dashed = output off. Select a layer, change the parameters below and click Apply. Changes apply only to this file and the current material choice; after the file is changed in xTool they must be made again.
strings.za dużo plików o nazwie %s w folderze za: too many files named %s in the output folder
Select one layer in the table.
strings.Zaznacz tak, jak w LightBurnie: Edit > D: Set these as in LightBurn: Edit > Device Settings > Mirror X / Mirror Y. If the project opens mirrored, change these options.
strings.Zmieniono bazę materiałów: ręczne zmiany: Material database changed: manual layer changes cleared (layer numbers may have changed).
